title: tragacantha formosa
intro: Tragacantha formosa, commonly known as the Golden Stag's Horn or Mexican Gold, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is used to treat various health conditions due to its medicinal properties, including the relief of anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation. The plant has been found to possess therapeutic actions such as anxiolytic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids. These constituents have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to the plant's potential health benefits.
